title: Plain-input SAT with a polynomial budget for long-clause variables
claims: LongClauseSATInP constructs a language in the exact reference P contained in the exact reference SAT. It decides satisfiability for any encoded CNF whose variables occurring in clauses of width greater than two have at most polynomially many assignments.
The backdoor is computed from the ordinary CNF encoding by checked polynomial-time collection and deduplication, with no auxiliary variable list supplied by the input.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
